from torch import nn

model = build_model()

name: one-epoch training smoke test
test:
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

torch.manual_seed(0)
images = torch.zeros(12, 1, 28, 28, dtype=torch.float32)
labels = torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.long) % 10
for index, label in enumerate(labels):
    images[index, 0, int(label), int(label)] = 1.0
loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(images, labels), batch_size=4, shuffle=False)
model = build_model()
trained = train_model(model, loader, loader, epochs=1, device='cpu')
if trained is not None:
    model = trained
assert isinstance(model, nn.Module), 'train_model must keep or return a torch.nn.Module'
with torch.no_grad():
    logits = model(images)
assert tuple(logits.shape) == (12, 10), f'expected logits shape (12, 10), got {tuple(logits.shape)}'
print('training smoke ok')
